- Addressing: name a repo by a prefixed path (gh/<owner>/<repo>, et/<project>/<repo>, git/<owner>/<repo>) or a repo ULID. fix(hooks): confine git hook installation to a rooted hooks directory

The active hooks directory was the last tree Entire wrote to with bare

osroot.ReadFileNoFollow; and replace the write with

script is. Refusing to read through someone's link must not mean silently
discarding it, and the rename preserves the link itself as the backup.

doctor grows checkGitHookSymlinks, reporting a symlinked hooks directory
(which stops installation, and is otherwise invisible: every other command
just reports the hooks absent) and a symlinked hook file (which is not an
error, only a surprise worth naming). It is a separate function from
